desc: 立领斜缀门襟小扣，无袖包边袖笼，内层裙身外层透纱的A字裙摆
leaf: 女童立领斜襟盘扣无袖中式连衣裙（内层裙身加外层透明罩纱）
name: 女童立领盘扣中式纱裙款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用无形人台正身挂拍把整条裙子的廓形、领型与双层裙摆一次讲清，画面无任何干扰元素。
主图一秒法则：左上竖排空白题签条加右侧主张位，把裙子的第一购买理由压缩成一眼可读的一句话。
shots.textZone: vertical title slip in moon-white linen #EDF0F1 at the upper left, one headline slot and one short subline slot on the right 34%

shots.intent: 放大夏天童裙贴身闷黏、领口与门襟压住脖颈的真实摩擦，用左右两个状态自证双层罩层的空隙结构。
shots.textZone: one short label slot at the base of each panel

shots.intent: 让买家把自己孩子代入日常客厅一刻：蓝灰亚麻软包扶手椅侧坐，裙摆自然铺开，验证外穿场合感。
解决套头穿脱与后颈压迫的疑虑：背向展示后中开合、领座走线与里层边缘，只讲结构不讲功效。
shots.textZone: one label slot in the lower right rail

shots.intent: 用领口与门襟第一枚结扣的微距证明手工结构与做工，是本品最强差异点的证据屏。
shots.textZone: one short label slot on the rice-paper band

shots.intent: 把 A 字裙摆的双层结构做成可见证据：贴地仰视内层裙边与外层透纱的边缘差，说明摆量与层次。
shots.textZone: one headline slot in the upper negative space

shots.intent: 让买家在几条色路里自选：同款裙身平铺成行，色名一律留给空白卡位，杜绝杜撰色号。
shots.textZone: three short label cells beneath the three colourways

shots.intent: 补一个真实居家使用场合：清晨窗边小坐，光落在罩纱上，让买家完成代入而非看参数。
把规格疑虑一次收干：参数栏与尺码表版式照搬结构，但所有档位、数字与单元格一律留空。
shots.textZone: one header slot on the ink-washed slip and one short note slot under the grid

shots.intent: 以做工与质检留位收口降风险：2x2 空白工艺窗格加一枚空方印框，只留卡位不编资质。
shots.textZone: one headline slot above the grid and four empty craft-window captions

style.backgroundSystem: moon-white fine-weave linen stretched on a frame #EDF0F1 as the neutral field for packshots, spec cards and twin comparison panels; one ink-washed rice-paper band #DDE4E6 laid across the upper third of that field as the only header container; a slate-blue linen-upholstered wing armchair with bare plain legs #6F8CA6 as the single recurring worn prop and furniture grade surface; deep turquoise seal-green board #2C7A68 reserved for the benefit banner and the closing screen; ink charcoal #1B2226 only ever as one hairline rule, one empty outline or one vertical title slip, never as a large field; no wood stage, no walnut plank, no arch opening, no draped sheer veil foreground, no lath or slat shadow, no outdoor ground, no street, no court, no second wall colour, no gradient
style.direction: ink-wash chinese folk children's apparel ecommerce, worn screens plus invisible-mannequin packshots plus airy construction close-ups
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline icons in ink charcoal #1B2226 drawn only inside 2x2 square grid windows with empty centres, plus one empty square seal outline with no mark inside used only on the closing screen; all seal, stamp and icon cells stay blank; no filled plates, no circles, no hexagons, no diamonds, no quatrefoils, no pill outlines, no numeral or step indicator rails, no scalloped cards, no circular photo masks, no certificate or badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool 6500K north-window daylight into a white bounce card, wide soft front-left diffusion, low contrast, one true contact shadow under every hem and card edge, glancing side light only on the collar and weave macros, worn screens lifted about 300K on the chair side, no harsh speculars, no warm cast, no rim flare, no coloured gels, no mixed light direction inside one panel
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent ink-wash chinese folk children's apparel visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of moon-white woven linen #EDF0F1, ink-washed rice-paper grey #DDE4E6, slate-blue linen upholstery #6F8CA6, turquoise seal-green #2C7A68 and ink charcoal #1B2226 with one accent colour only; cool soft north-window light at 6500K entering from the front-left with a white bounce card, low contrast, one true contact shadow under every hem and card edge; one modern geometric sans-serif with wide-tracked small-cap rails, rendered copy only as short bracketed placeholder slots and never as lifted source wording; hairline icon language inside square grid windows only, every icon and seal cell left blank; recurring components are the pale stretched-linen field, the rice-paper header band, the slate-blue linen wing armchair, one blank unprinted paper fan disc and one blank square seal outline; stable garment scale with the shoulder line at the same height in every worn and hanging screen and a visible air gap between the sheer outer layer and the inner layer; child figures always cropped below the chin, from behind or reduced to one hand; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush or calligraphy lettering, no random backgrounds, no walnut or timber stage, no arch opening, no draped veil panel, no slat-screen shadow, no inconsistent lighting, no warm cast, no mismatched icon styles, no filled icon plates, no step-indicator rails, no scalloped cards, no circular photo masks, no visible child face, no brand wordmark, no store badge, no QR code, no watermark, no invented certification artwork and no fabricated numerals or measurements.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no new accent hue outside turquoise seal-green #2C7A68 plus the ink-washed rice-paper band #DDE4E6
no mixed fonts, no serif, no brush lettering, no calligraphy and no oversized wall word
no random backgrounds, no walnut or timber stage, no arch opening, no draped veil panel and no slat-screen shadow bands
no inconsistent lighting, no warm cast, no rim flare, no coloured gels and no contradictory shadow direction
no mismatched icon styles, no filled icon plates, no scalloped cards, no circular photo masks and no step-indicator rails
no visible child face, no facial features, no brand wordmark, no store badge, no QR code, no watermark and no real certification artwork
style.presentationRules: garment scale and shoulder-line height stay constant across the set; the worn silhouette and the invisible-mannequin front always read as the same object; the outer sheer layer always stands away from the inner layer so the air gap stays visible; sleeves and necklines stay unobstructed and the label zone never covers a closure; a child figure is always cropped below the chin, shot from behind or reduced to one hand, so no face or facial feature is ever rendered; no invented second garment and no colourway outside what the reference photo shows
style.surfaceSystem: stretched moon-white linen #EDF0F1 doubling as backdrop and as the card stock of every inset and blank cell; ink-washed rice-paper band #DDE4E6 header stock; slate-blue linen upholstery #6F8CA6 with a visible plain weave; plain pale painted floor board under the hem screens; undyed linen upholstery, undyed cotton throw and unglazed pale ceramic as the only prop materials; the dress stays lint free, its own sheer outer layer is the only foreground veil, no debris and no dust in frame
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif carries every rendered slot in ink charcoal #1B2226, with one wide-tracked small-cap rail under each section header; in-image Chinese is always a placeholder reading 「{selling_point_1}」 through 「{selling_point_4}」 or 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_9}」, never a real sentence or a lifted source phrase; headline 28-44pt, subline 14-18pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; all body paragraphs collapse to blank dotted leader rails or empty table cells; no serif, no brush or calligraphy lettering, no handwriting, no script, no outline lettering, no oversized wall word, no mixed fonts
